combo_notes: Removed by Ice or Water. Air spreads Fire to nearby enemies.

description: Enemies take damage when hitting you
other_effect: Reflect 20% of melee damage taken back to the attacker.
combo_notes: Applied to yourself, not to enemies.

description: After a certain amount of damage given, a percentage of the opponent's health is taken.
other_effect: At 10 stacks the enemy bursts for 25% of its max health (champions and bosses: 8%), then stacks reset.

description: Damage over time but less intense, and weakens and slows enemies.
After a certain percentage of damage is given, the enemy dies.
other_effect: Heavy Attack Status enemy dies if its health drops below 20% (champions and bosses: 8%).

description: Enemies will fight for you after taking enough damage.
other_effect: At 5 stacks the enemy fights for you for 8 s. Champions and bosses can't be turned.

description: Blinded by sand: attacks miss more often and the enemy moves slower.
other_effect: Enemy attacks miss 40% of the time.

description: Heavy Attack Status by light: takes more damage and can't hide.
other_effect: +20% damage taken from all sources; reveals hidden enemies.
combo_notes: Light + Dark on one enemy = Light + Dark (duo godly gift).

description: Pulls enemies in and drains all stats for a little.
other_effect: Pulled 2 m toward the hit; -20% damage, move speed and attack speed.
At 3 stacks the enemy is Frozen (can't move or attack) for 1.5 s.
combo_notes: Removed by Fire. Water + Ice = instant freeze (duo godly gift).

description: Heals for a percentage of damage dealt.
other_effect: Damage you deal to this enemy heals you for 10% of it.
Lightning deals +50% damage to Soaked enemies. Puts out Fire.
Hits chain to 2 enemies within 4 m for 50% damage.
Knocked back 4 m; airborne enemies take +25% damage.

description: A stone blow knocks the enemy down and slows it.
other_effect: When it lands the enemy is knocked down (large ones only slowed); it moves 30% slower while it lasts.

description: A mark of Count Fuckula that builds on the player; when it fills, your godly gifts switch off for a moment.
other_effect: Applied to the player. At 5 stacks you are Hollowed: godly gifts switch off for 3 s, then the mark resets. Dodging a Void attack removes 1 stack.
combo_notes: Hitting a Void-marked enemy with Light or Stone clears all your stacks. Only the evil tribe uses Void.
